title: Flutter Packages
meta: Reusable Flutter packages and plugins with tests and docs, ready for your own apps or your team. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Flutter packages and plugins you can reuse
overview: When your Flutter apps share widgets or logic, we package them for reuse. We design a small, clear API, write unit and widget tests, add a README and an example app, and prepare versioning so your apps pick up changes safely. For features that need platform code, we build a plugin with Kotlin and Swift parts. You choose whether it stays private or goes to pub.dev.

pkgs.blurb: One small, tested Dart package with a README.
A larger package with docs, an example app and version tags.
A full plugin with platform code, tests and publishing set up.
list: Plugin with Kotlin and Swift code

faq: You do. It goes into your repository under the licence you choose, or stays private. We keep no rights and do not reuse your code for other clients.
Can you extract a package from my app?
Yes. We move shared widgets or logic into a package, tidy its interface and update the app to use it. Updating more apps is quoted separately.
Do you publish it to pub.dev?
Premium prepares everything, including the score checks and metadata. Publishing itself happens from your pub.dev account, so you stay the owner and we never hold it.
Can the package support web and desktop too?
Pure Dart packages usually do. Plugins with platform code need extra work for each target, so tell us which systems you need and we scope it before starting.
